Sync.Description: The centre's devices, its two laptops and the director's phone: each works alone, and they exchange their changes, sealed, whenever there is internet.
Sync.ManagerOnly: Only the manager sets up sync, adds or removes a device and settles conflicts.
Sync.NotSetUp: Sync is not set up on this device. The manager sets it up on his laptop.

Bar.Waiting: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting to be sent} one {# change waiting to be sent} other {# changes waiting to be sent}}

Exchange.OUTDATED: Update the program on this device

ProblemTitles.LEGAL_INCIDENT: Invoices or receipts from a removed device
ProblemTitles.REVOKED: This device was removed from sync
ProblemTitles.REJOIN: This device must join the centre again
ProblemTitles.CATCH_UP_OFFLINE: Waiting for the internet to catch up
ProblemTitles.CLOCK: This device's clock is not set right
ProblemTitles.HELD: Changes from another device are held
ProblemTitles.CONFLICTS: The same field was changed on two devices
ProblemTitles.LIMIT: The service has reached its daily limit
ProblemTitles.FILES_MISSING: Some stored files have not arrived yet
ProblemTitles.OUTDATED: Update the program on this device

ProblemHints.LEGAL_INCIDENT: {count, plural, one {# document was} other {# documents were}} issued on a device after its books were taken. They are kept whole below, outside the chain: the director decides what to do with them on paper.
ProblemHints.REVOKED: It was removed on another device. It keeps its data but exchanges nothing more. To work with the centre again, it must join with a new code.
ProblemHints.FULL: The mailbox refuses new envelopes. Nothing is lost: each device keeps its changes. Call the developer to free room.
ProblemHints.REJOIN: This database is older than what the mailbox still holds, or from before sync. Ask for a new code on the director's laptop and join again.
ProblemHints.CATCH_UP_OFFLINE: A copy was restored on this device: it must take back what the other devices did before anyone works. Connect it to the internet.
ProblemHints.CLOCK: It differs from the mailbox's time by {difference}. Correct the date and time of Windows.
ProblemHints.HELD: {count, plural, one {# change was} other {# changes were}} refused by this database. Open the list below and choose what to do.
ProblemHints.CONFLICTS: {count, plural, one {# field was} other {# fields were}} changed on two devices while apart. The later value was kept; the other one is below, one click to use it.
ProblemHints.LIMIT: The free service resumes at {time}. Every device keeps working; what waits is sent then.
ProblemHints.OFFLINE: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waits.} one {# change waits and is sent when the internet returns.} other {# changes wait and are sent when the internet returns.}}
ProblemHints.FILES_MISSING: {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} still to arrive. They are fetched again at the next exchanges.
ProblemHints.OUTDATED: The mailbox no longer accepts this version of the program. Nothing is lost: this device keeps its changes and sends them once the latest version is installed on it.
ProblemHints.REMOVAL_UNFINISHED: A removed device is refused by the mailbox, but the centre key was not replaced after it. Remove it again from a laptop.

SetUp.Title: Set up sync
SetUp.Description: Done once, on the director's laptop, with the mailbox address and the setup key the developer gave. This laptop then holds the books.
SetUp.OriginHint: As the developer wrote it, starting with https.
SetUp.Done: Sync is set up. Add the second laptop and the director's phone now.
SetUp.Failed: Sync could not be set up.

Status.Title: The exchange
Status.Description: Where the exchange with the mailbox stands now.
Status.Joining: Finishing joining: no numbers are given until the first sync is complete.

Devices.Title: The centre's devices
Devices.Description: Two laptops and the director's phone at most. Each keeps the whole program and the whole database.
Devices.HoldsBooks: The books are on this device
Devices.Requested: The books were asked for on {date} at {time}. They move at the next exchange of the device that holds them.
Devices.RequestBooksHint: Invoices, receipts and payments are written only on the device that holds the books. They move within a minute while that device is open and online.
Devices.RequestBooksFailed: The books could not be asked for.
Devices.OnlyOne: Only this device is in sync yet.
Devices.PhoneBooksHint: The original of what is issued here prints from a laptop, once the books are back there.
Devices.WaitingFromIt: {count, plural, =0 {nothing of it waits here} one {# of its changes waits to be applied here} other {# of its changes wait to be applied here}}
Devices.BooksOnRemoved: The books were left on this removed device

Pair.Title: Add the second laptop
Pair.Description: The assistant signs in on her laptop with her own account. Choose it, or create it now.
Pair.New: A new account for the assistant
Pair.NoOtherAccount: The centre has no account but the manager's: create the assistant's.
Pair.DisplayNameHint: Surname first, as on his forms.
Pair.PasswordHint: She replaces it at her first sign-in. At least {min} characters.
Pair.CodeHint: On the second laptop: install the program, choose «Join an existing centre», then type the mailbox address and this code.
Pair.Expired: This code has expired. Close and ask for a new one.
Pair.Failed: The pairing code could not be made.
Pair.PhoneDescription: The phone is the director's: he signs in on it with his own account and his usual password. Only the manager's accounts sign in on a phone.
Pair.PhoneCodeHint: On the phone: install the program, open it, choose «Join an existing centre», then type the mailbox address and this code.

Remove.Title: Remove a device
Remove.Description: For a device that is lost, broken or replaced. Its access to the mailbox is revoked at once and the centre's key is replaced. To bring it back, it must join again with a new code.
Remove.HeldBooks: This device holds the books. Type the last invoice and receipt numbers you can see on paper: the numbers up to them are set aside, so that none is issued twice.
Remove.Failed: The device could not be removed.
Remove.TakeBackDescription: The books were handed to this device while it was being removed. They come to this device, and the numbers up to those you type are set aside.
Remove.TakeBackDone: The books are on this device.
Remove.TakeBackFailed: The books could not be taken back.
Remove.CodesVoided: Any pairing code made before this removal no longer works. Make a new code to add a device.
Remove.OfflineWarning: A device that is only offline, not lost, loses whatever it has not sent yet if it is removed.

Conflicts.Title: Sync conflicts
Conflicts.Description: What two devices did to the same record while apart. Nothing is lost: every other value is kept here.
Conflicts.Deleted: Deleted on one device, changed on another
Conflicts.Incident: Issued after its books were taken
Conflicts.Used: The other value is used, on every device.
Conflicts.Failed: The conflict could not be settled.

Held.Title: Held changes
Held.Description: Changes from another device that this database refused. They are tried again at every exchange; a later change may unblock them.

Reasons.UNIQUE: The same thing was registered on two devices (the same national number, a second accepted quote, the same slot).
Reasons.MISSING_PARENT: The record it belongs to is missing on this device.
Reasons.IN_USE: Another record still points at the one deleted on another device.
Reasons.RULE: A rule of the program refused it here (a closed pay run, a decided sanction…).
Reasons.WAITS: It waits for another held change.

Held.SetAsideDescription: The newer record is set aside (it stays in the log), and the held change is applied.
Held.Done: Done. The other devices follow at their next exchange.

SyncJoin.OfferHint: A new device for a centre that already works on a laptop.
SyncJoin.Title: Join an existing centre
SyncJoin.Description: On the director's laptop: Settings › Sync › «Add the second laptop». Type here the address and the code it shows.
SyncJoin.Restart: The program restarts on the centre's accounts.
SyncJoin.Failed: Joining failed. Check the address and the code, and the internet.

CatchUp.Title: Taking back what the other devices did
CatchUp.Hint: A copy was restored on this device. It takes back from the mailbox what it sent after that copy and everything from the other devices, then opens.
CatchUp.Offline: There is no internet. This device waits, and goes on as soon as it is connected.
CatchUp.Wait: Nobody can work on this device until it has caught up.
CatchUp.ManagerChoice: The manager may instead take this device out of sync.
CatchUp.Leave: Take this device out of sync
CatchUp.LeaveDescription: This device then works alone, as before sync, and the others go on without it. To bring it back, it must join again with a new code.
CatchUp.LeaveFailed: This device could not be taken out of sync.

Rejoin.Title: This device must join the centre again
Rejoin.Hint: This database is from before sync was set up, or older than what the mailbox still holds. This device joins again from the centre's full copy, with its own keys, then restarts.
Rejoin.Submit: Join again from the centre's copy

Access.SignedOut: Your account was switched off on another device. You have been signed out.
Access.Changed: Your access was changed on another device.

SyncJoin.PhoneDescription: On the director's laptop: Settings › Sync › «Add the director's phone». Type here the address and the code it shows.
SyncJoin.PhoneOnlyHint: A centre starts on the director's laptop. This phone joins it: the centre's copy arrives here, then the director signs in with his own account.

SyncAttention.Title: Sync needs attention
SyncAttention.Hint: Conflicts, held changes, or a problem with the exchange between the centre's devices

Errors.BooksOnOtherLaptop: The books are on another device. Ask for them, and try again when they have arrived.
Errors.BooksOnTheirWay: The books are on their way to this device: the last invoices and receipts have not all arrived yet. Try again in a minute.
Errors.BooksAlreadyHere: The books are already on this device.
Errors.BooksNotOnThatLaptop: The books are not on that device.
Errors.ClaimOutsideBlocks: This number is not among those given before sync was set up, nor among this device's own numbers: it cannot be typed here.
Errors.PaperNumberLastSeen: Type the last number seen on paper, from 0 to 999999.
Errors.SyncAlreadySetUp: Sync is already set up on this device.
Errors.SyncNotSetUp: Sync is not set up on this device.
Errors.SyncSetupKey: The mailbox refused this setup key.
Errors.SyncNotMailbox: No mailbox answers at this address. Check the address the developer gave.
Errors.SyncOffline: The mailbox cannot be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
Errors.SyncLimit: The mailbox has reached its daily limit. Try again after 01:00.
Errors.SyncFull: The mailbox is full. Ask the developer to free some room.
Errors.SyncTwoLaptops: The centre already has its two laptops. Remove one first.
Errors.SyncCodeUnknown: This code is not valid, or was already used, or has expired. Ask for a new code.
Errors.SyncCodeTypo: This code is mistyped. Check each group of four characters.
Errors.SyncHasWork: This device already holds work. A device joins a centre only when it is freshly installed.
Errors.SyncNoCopy: The mailbox holds no full copy of the centre yet. Try again in a few minutes.
Errors.SyncManagerRole: The assistant's account cannot have the manager's role.
Errors.SyncDeviceUnknown: This device is not part of the centre.
Errors.SyncDeviceThis: This device cannot remove itself. Remove it from another device of the centre.
Errors.SyncRevoked: This device was removed from the centre.
Errors.SyncConflictUnknown: This conflict does not exist or was already settled.
Errors.SyncHeldUnknown: This held change does not exist or was already settled.
Errors.SyncRecordGone: This record was deleted on one of the devices: its value cannot be put back.
Errors.SyncActionNotAllowed: This record cannot be settled that way.
Errors.SyncStillRefused: The database still refuses this change. Fix the cause first.
Errors.SyncCatchingUpNoNumbers: This device is taking back from the mailbox what it did after the backup. Try again when it has caught up.
Errors.SyncLeftWithoutBooks: This device was taken out of sync while another device held the books: invoices, receipts and payments are issued there only.
Errors.SyncCodeForLaptop: This code was made for a laptop. On the laptop, choose “Add the director's phone” to get a code for the phone.
Errors.SyncCodeForPhone: This code was made for the director's phone. On the other laptop, choose “Add the second laptop” to get a code for a laptop.
Errors.SyncPhoneTaken: The centre already has the director's phone. Remove it first.
Errors.SyncOutdated: This program is too old for the mailbox. Install the latest version on this device.
Errors.SyncPhoneSetUp: A phone cannot set up sync. Set it up on the director's laptop, then add the phone from there.
Errors.BooksOnDirectorLaptop: The books are on the director's laptop. Ask for them, and try again when they have arrived.
Errors.BooksOnSecondLaptop: The books are on the second laptop. Ask for them, and try again when they have arrived.
Errors.BooksOnDirectorPhone: The books are on the director's phone. Ask for them, and try again when they have arrived.
Errors.SyncPhoneCannotPair: A phone cannot add a device. Add it from a laptop.
Errors.SyncJoiningNoNumbers: This device has just joined the centre and is still receiving its latest changes. Try again when it has synced.
Errors.SyncFirst: This device has not yet received everything the mailbox holds. Check the internet connection, sync, and try again.
Errors.SyncPhoneRemoves: A phone cannot remove a device. Remove it from a laptop.
Errors.SyncKeyNotReplaced: The device is refused by the mailbox, but the centre key is not replaced yet. Try the removal again from a laptop.
Errors.BooksStayOnLaptops: The books stay on the laptops: issue this from the laptop that holds the books.
Errors.BooksHeldHere: Documents of the books are held on this device: settle them in the sync conflicts first, then try again.
